_comment: Phase 0 (2026-10-20), owner decisions applied. Rules are evaluated top to bottom; first match wins. Matching fields: gtfs_route_type, gtfs_operator (attributions.txt organization_name), gtfs_route_short_name, trv_product (TrainAnnouncement.ProductInformation), trv_type_of_traffic (Tåg | Pendeltåg | Buss). Trafikverket fields are only available for trains within its ~4-day history / ~15-day future window; GTFS-only rules must stand on their own for historical legs. See DATA_FINDINGS.md §5.

exclude.reason: Replacement/connecting bus filed under a train number
Värmlandstrafik on-demand taxi (route 'Anrop') filed as route_type 100
Trams/light rail (Lidingöbanan, Nockebybanan, Tvärbanan, Spårväg City, Göteborg/Norrköping/Lund trams)
Trip calls at stops with no railway station nearby (e.g. SJ 6xxxx buses via Cityterminalen, Snälltåget ski buses). Computed from the station mapping.

rules.note: Göteborg commuter trains (Kungsbacka/Alingsås/Älvängen lines). Station set learned from Trafikverket 'Pendeltåg' Västtågen on 2026-10-19; on 2026-10-20 it reproduced Trafikverket exactly (303 commuter, 320 regional, 0 errors). Works for historical legs without Trafikverket data.
SL Pendeltåg (route_short_name is the line number, not the train number)
Saltsjöbanan (AB Stockholms Spårvägar). Not in Trafikverket: legs will be scheduled_only
Roslagsbanan (Transdev). Not in Trafikverket: legs will be scheduled_only
Owner decision 2026-10-20 (owner delegated): commuter, per spec §11 for Pågatåg; Östgötapendeln is a commuter service by name and pattern. Trafikverket labels both 'Tåg'.

Owner decision 2026-10-20 (owner delegated): regional, so the commuter toggle does not hide airport trips. GTFS files it as route_type 101. Not in Trafikverket ('Arlanda Express visas ej'): legs will be scheduled_only
Trafikverket regional products, checked before GTFS route_type (SJ files some regional trains as route_type 100)
High speed, long distance, inter-regional, sleeper
Default for remaining rail: Västtågen, Mälartåg, Krösatåg*, Öresundståg (VR Sverige AB), Tåg i Bergslagen, Norrtåg, X-Tåget, Värmlandstrafik, Tågab, SJ Norge, SJ Regional

train_number.fallback: If no exact match in Trafikverket for the date, retry with the leading digit removed for 5-digit numbers (Snälltåget 90306 → 306, Öresundståg 51053 → 1053) and accept only if an advertised time matches.

display.note: Owner decision 2026-10-20: show the brand/product (Öresundståg, Pågatåg, SJ Snabbtåg), keep the operating company as secondary data. GTFS attributions and Trafikverket Operator disagree on companies (Öresundståg: VR Sverige AB vs ARRIVA).
